steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each leaver is placed by its reason code, and each rate by its headcount base.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Leaver with no reason code
findings.fix: Code the reason from the exit record

findings.title: Rate computed on a headcount that does not match the period
Reasons given beyond the codes not recorded
findings.fix: Note the reasons in the exit record

outcome.notChecked: The reasons given beyond the codes.
